none: PAS IOW-636316: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Isle of Wight (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete and very worn Roman copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian dating to the period AD 364-378 (Reece period 19). Probably a GLORIA ROMANORVM reverse type depicting emperor advancing right holding standard and dragging captive. Uncertain mint. Obverse: Illegible legend, Uncertain diademed and draped(?) bust right. Reverse: [ ]OMAN[ ], Illegible reverse type. Diameter: 16.5mm.…
